item.title: Dear Abby: Relatives enter woman’s life after ignoring her for years
item.description: DEAR ABBY: I am a 38-year-old woman with a 21-year-old daughter, “Penny.” I got pregnant at 16 and was very much alone, with little help from those around me.

item.title: Central Catholic students among H-T Diocese award-winners
item.description: Submitted photo Bishop Simon Peter Engurait is shown with winners in the Diocese of Houma-Thibodaux Student of the Year program. Among the winners are senior Gabriella Morice, eighth-grader Mason Wisdom and fifth-grader Mary Margaret Montgomery, all of Central Catholic. Annually celebrated during Catholic Schools Week, the Diocese of Houma-Thibodaux’s Student of the Year program honored its winners Wednesday.

item.title: Parish Council OKs $500,000 for Bayou Vista drainage

item.title: Galatea, Amani kids up next for Mardi Gras
item.description: Jamie Heyl Photography King and Queen Galatea LVI Wayne Mayon Sr. and Angela Kraemer were crowned at the 2025 Galatea ball and tableau. Cre Jenay Photography King Jamal Harvey Jr. and Queen Blair Nash reigned at the 2025 Krewe of Amani Kids ball. The Krewe of Galatea and the Amani Kids Krewe take their respective stages Saturday as East St. Mary’s Mardi Gras celebration winds closer to the big day.
